references.matching_note: The ambient extension is a general inclusion of fields.
Algebraicity is the corresponding extension-field property.
The Galois extension must be separable in the field-theoretic sense.
Normality is the existing normal algebraic extension property.
Automorphisms fixing the base field are independently indexed.
